display-small.purpose: Full saved value with tabular numerals.

title-medium.purpose: Section headings, selected dates, and history values.

body-large.purpose: Native reading text with tabular numerals.

body-medium.purpose: Reading text and percentages with tabular numerals.

label-large.purpose: Compact labels that explain the value.

label-medium.purpose: Small contextual labels such as latest change.

label-small.purpose: Measured numeric and date axis labels.

components.name: Save button
components.description: Native Material filled Button; minimum height token, busy-state disablement, and a 56 dp minimum in the inline entry row.

components.name: Entry date
components.description: Native OutlinedButton opens Material DatePicker; a draft uses Entry date while a saved value uses Recorded on.

components.name: Value field
components.description: Native OutlinedTextField with decimal keyboard, LTR input, sign toggle, Done action, persistent label, and textual errors.

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Labeled native Material navigation bar below the rail width threshold, rail at or above it; three destinations.

components.name: Settings choice
components.description: Full-width selectable native radio row; the height token is a minimum.

components.name: Entry dock
components.description: Native low-tone Surface with the matching light or dark dock token; scrollable form limited to half the available root height.

components.name: Body-only chart
components.description: Compose Canvas for real recorded Open/Close bodies, with selection cues, reset, viewport gestures, and textual details; no invented wicks or highs/lows.

components.name: Change details
components.description: Direction icon and label, full signed amount, and percentage or its unavailable explanation; resolved through the current change-color provider.

narrative.overview:
Daily Balance is clean, modern, focused, and understated. The visual system puts saved values, dates, and changes ahead of decoration. Open sections and restrained dividers keep dense information readable without a stack of oversized cards.

This is a native Android system built with Jetpack Compose Material 3. Brand expression comes from its paired color schemes, a small set of typography overrides, and shared spacing and shapes. Geometry uses Android dp; text uses sp and follows system font scale. No custom font or separate visual metaphor is established.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet neutral light surfaces and deep green dark surfaces.
Teal primary actions with native Material controls.
Full numeric values and textual evidence beside the chart.
English and Persian content with Android RTL behavior.

rules.name: The Redundant Change Rule
rules.body: Always present change with its direction label, icon, and signed value as well as its semantic color.

rules.name: The Full Value Rule
rules.body: Keep stored amounts selectable, unwrapped, and horizontally scrollable when needed; do not shorten or truncate the value to fit a layout.

rules.name: The Native Depth Rule
rules.body: Use Material surface roles and component elevation instead of introducing arbitrary drop shadows or ornamental layers.

dos: Do resolve color through Material theme roles and the current change-color provider.
Do keep full values, dates, Open, Close, and change readable in text.
Do preserve native dp/sp sizing, safe-drawing and IME insets, font-scale adaptation, and RTL resources.
Do use the shared type roles, spacing, shapes, and native Material interaction states.
donts: Don't add gradients, flashy effects, decorative imagery, or oversized card stacks.
Don't rely on color alone to explain direction or selection.
Don't invent high/low values, wicks, missing daily values, or market predictions.
Don't label an unsaved draft date as a recorded value.
